candidates.description: Late fifties, Tennessee-born drifter. A dry, low, slightly gravelly baritone worn by tobacco and trail dust. Speaks slowly and evenly, long pauses, a faint Southern drawl, never hurried, quietly amused. Voice of a man on the 1880s American frontier, recorded close and dry like a film actor's dialogue, no music, no room echo. Unpolished and lived-in, not a modern announcer or narrator, not radio-smooth, no corporate or audiobook polish.
